_about: Every sound the app can play. The app looks cues up by id; replace a file by dropping a recording at the same path and setting placeholder to false (see docs/CREDITS.md). Then run: node scripts/gen-audio.cjs (it regenerates placeholders and src/audio/sources.ts).

cues.describe: Your own draw from the wall: a soft tile slide.
Any discard landing in a pond: a wooden clack.
流局: the wall ran out with no winner, a falling two-note sigh.
You won the hand: a short rising fanfare under the 胡 call.
Clock tick each second for the last 5 seconds of your turn.
UI tap: picking a tile, pressing a claim button.
Mandarin call 吃 (chī) when any seat claims a chow.
Mandarin call 碰 (pèng) for a pong.
Mandarin call 槓 (gàng) for any kong.
Mandarin call 胡 (hú) for a win off a discard.
Mandarin call 自摸 (zìmō) for a self-drawn win.
Taiwanese Hokkien call for 吃. Not recorded yet: the call shows as a banner only.
Taiwanese Hokkien call for 碰. Not recorded yet.
Taiwanese Hokkien call for 槓. Not recorded yet.
